/* codex-ui-customizer:file-links:v2 */if(r==null&&n==null){
    try {
      if ((await oo.workspace.fs.stat(v)).type & oo.FileType.Directory) return false;
      await oo.commands.executeCommand("vscode.open",v,{preview:false});
      await oo.commands.executeCommand("revealInExplorer",v);
      return true;
    } catch (codexUiLinkError) {
      if (codexUiLinkError?.code === "FileNotFound" || codexUiLinkError?.code === "ENOENT") return false;
      try {
        await oo.commands.executeCommand("codexUiCustomizer.reportFileLinkError", "" + codexUiLinkError);
      } catch {}
      return false;
    }
  }
